title: Impact of Stress First Aid for Workers in Substance Misuse Settings
official: Impact of Stress First Aid for Workers in Substance Misuse Settings
summary: Test the effectiveness of SFA adapted for the substance use outreach workforce compared to a no treatment control condition on social-support and burnout of HRWs in a cluster-randomized hybrid type I trial.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* At least 18 years of age
* In a paid or volunteer role as a substance use outreach worker or community health/outreach worker (whose work includes substance use outreach) with people who use drugs within TX, LA, AR, OK, NM and tribal areas
* Able and willing to provide informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

\- Inability to provide consent

sites.f: The University of Texas at Austin
